_comment: Which wireframe covers which visualiser THIS instance (fhir-harness) declares, by route key `<instance>/<visualiser>`. The same shape as the platform's own docs/wireframes/index.json: a wireframe sits with the page it draws, and check:wireframes reads the `wireframes/` of every `docs` directory an instance declares. Here because `ig-ast` is declared by this layer, so its wireframe and the viewer land together. `wireframe.css` is the shared mid-fidelity stylesheet, copied from the platform's docs/wireframes/ so the drawing renders here on its own.
